prompts.core:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready authored pixel-art sprite animation board for a 2D side-scrolling fan game.
Create a brand new CORE animation board of COCOON, the specific giant unmanned mobile fortress from Metal Gear Solid Peace Walker (1974), with maximal fidelity to its official Konami / Square Enix Play Arts Kai design. Do not paste an official photograph: draw original game-ready bitmap art.
Canonical identity: a dark charcoal gray, towering multi-tier mobile fortress on FOUR enormous boxy independent caterpillar tread modules. In a strict right-facing side view, the two near-side tread modules are clearly separated front/back, with hints of the two far-side modules. A wide low armored lower platform carries numerous small defensive turrets and orange/copper hinges. Above it, a thick central turntable supports a tall box-shaped rotating upper fortress with flat steel armor panels, ladders, tiny vents, multiple machine-gun turrets, and the distinctive large cannon pointing RIGHT. A narrow upright black cylindrical AI pod with an orange cap rises above the upper section. A long pale ivory articulated hydraulic crane/chainsaw arm is folded across the upper rear with its dark cutting end tucked close. Keep the true massive rectangular tiered silhouette, not an ordinary tank, not Pupa, not Shagohod, no legs, no giant humanoid head, no railgun, no hover thrusters.
Style: crisp high-detail 2D pixel sprite art, hard pixels, restrained charcoal/steel palette, orange warning details, pale articulated arm, subtle mechanical shading, consistent top-left light. No painterly blur, no scene lighting.
Layout: square 2048 by 2048 requested, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells. PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF flat background. Thin pure CYAN #00FFFF calibration grid: exactly five full-height vertical lines and five full-width horizontal lines including the outside borders. No titles, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos or watermark.
Every cell contains ONE complete full vehicle at the SAME scale and same fixed ground baseline. Strict side-on orthographic camera at track height; front/cannon faces RIGHT throughout. Center each vehicle. Keep at least 40 source pixels of empty magenta margin on ALL sides of every cell around the vehicle, cannon, arm and any smoke/flash. No cropping, no shadow floor, no perspective changes, no overlap across grid boundaries.
Animation instructions, each row is four independently DRAWN consecutive phases, not repeated stills with whole-image shifts:
Row 1 IDLE: subtle distinct mechanical idling, vent shutters opening/closing a little, upper suspension settling slightly, AI indicator pulses, small turret barrel elevation changes; lower chassis remains grounded.
Row 2 MOVE: four tread-motion phases, distinct positions of track links and visible drive wheels, small suspension compression and upper armor inertia, same world anchor and no lateral travel across cells.
Row 3 CHARGE/AIM: actual pre-fire cannon preparation, barrel elevates from lowered to level right, turret settles into aim, mechanical recoil mechanism braces, 4 increasingly ready poses. This is a cannon aiming telegraph, not an electrical charge beam.
Row 4 ATTACK: four genuine MECHANICAL cannon recoil phases WITHOUT any muzzle flash, smoke, or other visual effect: long barrel ready and level right, shorter sharply recoiled barrel with compressed sleeve, halfway returning barrel, full extension regained with subtle turret settlement. The game supplies separate firing effects: DO NOT DRAW ANY muzzle flash, smoke, sparks, projectile or beam in any cell. All structural identity remains constant in all 16 poses.
Reference observations: official licensed product photos show four independent track blocks, high central armored tower, cylindrical AI pod, small corner turrets and pale articulated chainsaw crane. Reproduce this recognizable silhouette faithfully while adapting it for right-facing pixel-game playback.
Critical identity reminder: upper fortress is a WIDE HORIZONTAL RECTANGULAR BOX above a circular central support, not a narrow vertical tower; MAIN GUN projects from the UPPER FRONT RIGHT face of that box. The AI pod is mounted ON THE ROOF and rises ABOVE the box as the highest dark cylindrical element, NOT next to the cannon at base level. Pale multi-jointed crane folds over the upper left roof. A huge wide four-track base supports it. Every gun and crane tip remains inside its cell with clear empty magenta padding. Do not draw any effects at all.

review.identity: Four independent tread blocks, circular central pivot, rectangular upper fortress, numerous defensive turrets, roof-mounted cylindrical AI pod, pale articulated crane/chainsaw arm, main cannon pointing right
review.actions: Core idle/move/charge/attack; special recover/hit/death/scan; four independent drawn phases per action
review.limitations: Original side-view pixel-art adaptation, not an official asset or a claim of 1:1 fidelity. Small structural/proportion variation remains between independently generated boards. Cannon flashes/projectiles are separate runtime effects, not baked into these actor sheets.
rejectedAttempts: Initial core board rejected: row 4 phase 2 muzzle flash touched cell boundary
Second core rejected: flash overlapped cyan divider
Third core rejected: incorrect narrow upper tower and misplaced AI pod
Initial special board replaced because upper-box and cannon proportions drifted too far from core
review.fileEditLimitation: Built-in referenced-image editing could not read the local source due to Windows helper apply deny-read ACLs; new boards were generated with the built-in tool, never through CLI/API fallback
review.validation: Strict importer passed: 2 sheets, 32 distinct authored poses, 8 actions; all source cells passed no-clipping checks

calibration.method: One uniform special-board scale with core idle frame 0 and special scan frame 12 anchoring the baseline; no per-pose scaling or pose synthesis
